map.通过简单问卷判断你的皮肤类型，获取基础护肤建议。: Use a short questionnaire to determine your skin type and get basic skincare recommendations.
map.按出油、紧绷、敏感等维度问卷计分，综合得分落入对应区间判定干性/油性/混合/中性: The questionnaire scores dimensions such as oiliness, tightness and sensitivity, and the combined score falling into a band determines dry, oily, combination, normal or sensitive skin. A large gap between the T-zone and cheek scores suggests combination skin. Results follow the sensations you report, so retest when the season changes.
map.洁面后 1 小时，脸部感觉如何？: One hour after cleansing, how does your face feel?
map.整体偏油，T区明显: Oily overall, clearly so in the T-zone
map.T区明显，两颊细腻: Noticeably large in the T-zone, fine on the cheeks
map.是否容易敏感、泛红或刺痛？: Do you get sensitive, red or stinging easily?
map.经常出油长痘、黑头: Often oily with acne and blackheads
map.T区黑头多，两颊少: Many blackheads in the T-zone, few on the cheeks
map.上妆后状态？: How does your skin look after makeup?
map.易脱妆、出油: Makeup slides off, skin gets oily
map.T区脱妆，两颊卡粉: T-zone makeup slides off, cheeks cake
map.T区油光，两颊哑光: Oily shine in the T-zone, matte cheeks
map.回答全部问题后点击测试。: Click test after answering all questions.
map.护肤前不确定自己是干性、油性还是混合性，用问卷自测。: Not sure whether your skin is dry, oily or combination before you start skincare? Use this questionnaire to self-test.
map.换季皮肤状态变化，重新评估当前肤质调整产品。: Skin condition changes with the seasons, so re-evaluate your current skin type and adjust your products.
map.美妆柜姐依据肤质给客户推荐洁面与面霜类型。: Beauty counters recommend cleanser and cream types to clients based on their skin type.
map.设出油维度 12 分（满分 20）、紧绷维度 15 分（满分 20）、敏感维度: Set oiliness at 12 points (20 max), tightness at 15 points (20 max) and sensitivity at 8 points (20 max). High oiliness with low tightness points to oily skin; high tightness with low oiliness points to dry skin; an oily T-zone with dry cheeks points to combination skin. The combined score falling into a band yields the skin type.
map.测出混合性该怎么护肤？: What should I do if I test as combination skin?
map.分区护理：T 区控油、两颊保湿。洁面选氨基酸类温和不拔干，两颊叠加面霜，避免全脸: Care for the zones separately: control oil in the T-zone and moisturize the cheeks. Choose a gentle amino-acid cleanser that does not strip, layer a cream on the cheeks, and avoid strong-cleansing products all over the face.
map.结果会随季节变吗？: Do the results change with the season?
map.会。冬季偏干、夏季偏油很常见，建议换季各测一次；敏感肌还受环境温湿度影响，以当下: Yes. Being drier in winter and oilier in summer is common, so test once per season. Sensitive skin is also affected by ambient temperature and humidity, so judge by your current state.
